Regarding issues concerning Southern States particularly Kerala 

SHRI TEJASVI SURYA (BANGALORE SOUTH): Hon. Chairperson Sir, I would want to seek your permission to raise an issue concerning the southern States in general and Kerala in particular.

Over the last few days, unfortunately, the landslides in Wayanad have taken away the lives of more than 160 innocent people. Over the last five years, more than 350 people have died due to landslides, disasters and accidents in Kerala. The unbridled and unregulated economic and commercial activities, including quarrying and mining in eco-sensitive areas of the Western Ghats are the primary reasons for this. Many reports were submitted earlier which were rejected successively by the UDF and the LDF Governments in Kerala in the last so many years. ? (Interruptions)

? (व्यवधान)

SHRI TEJASVI SURYA: Sir, in the last so many years, there has not been any long-term effort that has been made. ? (Interruptions)
